Gerador.TipoTesouroDica: Half divides Money by 2; Double rolls twice on each column.
Gerador.VezesDica: One roll per defeated creature, or one for the encounter's CL.

Chat.Dica: Drag items onto a sheet or chest. Click to open.
Chat.Arraste: Drag onto a sheet or chest
Chat.NaoEncontrado: not found in the active compendiums

Catalogo.Explicacao: Every physical item (weapon, equipment, consumable, treasure) in the active compendiums and in the world is read on each roll. Items listed in the book tables use the book weight; the others (custom) are classified automatically and get the table's average weight. Use the Override column to fix any item's category.

Limpar.Confirmar: Delete from the world every item created by the generator (superior, magic, valuables and coins)? Items already dragged onto sheets or chests are not affected.

Catalogo.Dica: Choose which compendiums are used and override each item's category.

IncluirMundo.Dica: Items created in the Items tab are also rolled (copies of compendium items are skipped).

ExtrasSistema.Dica: Includes system compendium items that are not in the book's treasure tables (vehicles, origin items, food…).

Alimentos.Dica: Dishes and food from custom compendiums join the Miscellaneous category.

Peso.Dica: Chance multiplier for items not in the book tables. 1 = average chance of a table entry; 0 = never.

Moedas.Dica: Creates a treasure item representing the coins so they can be dragged into the chest.

Copiar.Dica: Creates a world copy even for unmodified items. When off, the chat links straight to the compendium item.

Pasta.Dica: Name of the Items tab folder that holds the generator's items.

Rolagens.Dica: Adds a collapsible block with every roll made to the card.

Erros.ApenasMestre: Only the GM can generate treasure.
Erros.SistemaIncompativel: T20 Treasure Generator was made for the Tormenta20 system.
